subject: Geopolitics
title: Energy and Climate Diplomacy
description: One-minute skill: Energy and Climate Diplomacy.

hook.text: Rich nations caused most carbon emissions. Poor nations suffer most from warming. The argument over who pays never ends.

buildup.text: The Paris Agreement asks every nation to set emission targets. Compliance is voluntary. Enforcement is absent.

discovery.text: Climate diplomacy is energy diplomacy in disguise. Who transitions fastest determines who leads the next economy.

twist.text: Fossil fuel exporting nations resist fast timelines. Small island states demand urgency. The gap is existential.

punchline.text: Climate talks are energy battles in polite language.

quiz.question: Why is the Paris Agreement difficult to enforce?
options: Compliance is voluntary with no enforcement mechanism
It only applies to developing nations
